build.name: Full Teardown
build.about: Bottom of the league with an older roster and little youth, so the fastest path is to sell everything.
plan: Sell every vet now for picks; each loss improves your own pick.
Aim the tank at the 1.01 and stack firsts in the next two drafts.
Take young upside fliers as throw-ins in every deal.
reasons: 10th of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (134.7)
40% of player value is 24 or younger (5th most)

build.name: Pick Hoarder
build.about: An outsized share of value sits in draft picks.
plan: Picks lose value as the draft nears unless they're early; know which ones to use and which to flip.
Turn late firsts into young players who already produce.
Package several picks to move up for a top-three pick in a strong class.
reasons: 11th of 12 in points a week the rest of the way (82.2)
80% of player value is 24 or younger (2nd most)
